findings.headline: Move this ComponentProps type import off solid-js.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.3's solid-js ComponentProps accepts components only; the @solidjs/web version also accepts intrinsic tag names such as "button", which ComponentProps<"button"> needs.
findings.guidance: Move this specifier to a separate import type { ComponentProps } from "@solidjs/web" statement, leaving every other solid-js binding in place. Also set compilerOptions.jsxImportSource to @solidjs/web in tsconfig.json, which this analyzer does not scan.
